storage.notes: microSD/microSDHC/microSDXC slot with AES-XTS-Plain64 256-bit SD encryption; recording to network-attached storage (NAS) supported.

features: ARTPEC-8 SoC with deep learning processing unit (DLPU)
AXIS Object Analytics: human/vehicle detection and classification (cars, buses, trucks, bikes, other)
AXIS Scene Metadata, AXIS Image Health Analytics, AXIS Video Motion Detection, AXIS Live Privacy Shield included
Lightfinder 2.0 (0.06 lux colour) and Forensic WDR up to 120 dB
Remote pan-tilt-roll-zoom (PTRZ) with autofocus, P-Iris and remote zoom/focus
ONVIF Profiles G, M, S and T
Axis Edge Vault: signed OS, secure boot, TPM 2.0 (CC EAL4+, FIPS 140-2 Level 2), secure element (CC EAL6+), signed video
SIP/VoIP support and network speaker pairing
IP66, NEMA 4X and IK10 rated metal casing with integrated weathershield
release_notes: No built-in microphone or speaker; audio is via a 3.5 mm mic/line input and network speaker pairing, with two-way (half/full duplex) audio streaming. Also powerable via 10-28 V DC. Resolution modes: 2688x1512 (16:9), 1280x800 (16:10) or 2016x1512 (4:3). Max 50/60 fps without WDR; up to 25/30 fps with Forensic WDR.

frigate.notes: Standard Axis VAPIX RTSP path. ONVIF Profile S/T for discovery and streams.

home_assistant.notes: Native Axis integration with auto-discovery via Zeroconf.

blue_iris.notes: Select 'Axis' profile. Auto-discovery via ONVIF usually works.
